rows.grounds: locative adverb referring to the center

items.question: What geometric construction should be made in the middle of the yantra?
premises: Three circles should be made in the middle.
Twenty lines should be used there.
The construction occurs in the yantra's center.
items.inference: The verse prescribes three circles drawn with twenty lines in the center.
uncertainties: Exact referent of tatra is not explicit in this verse.
items.plain_english: In the middle, one should make three circles there with twenty lines.
